source_credit: AtlasFC official public video; broadcast images include TUDN branding. No open reuse license identified.
method: Each cinematic output frame is paired with the exact original video image at round(cinematic.source_time_per_frame[i] * 30000/1001). Integer ffmpeg frame selection; no synthesized photographs. The reviewed joints2d dictionary is overlaid without additional fitting or interpolation.
limitations: Replay timing is not physical event timing.
Unreviewed or occluded landmarks retain model estimates; red points mark manual review.
No 2D skeleton is drawn when the original frame has no accepted pose.
Right panel can interpolate short missing-pose gaps, as declared in the Blender manifest.
3D depth and contacts are inferred; no metric scene calibration.
At nearest-frame holds the photo repeats while the cinematic camera and interpolated pose may advance.
